source.sanitized: Sanitized from the ACP spike logs: home paths replaced with /home/user, emails and key or token shapes redacted, availableCommands emptied (they list installed skills), model and option lists trimmed to 5 entries plus the current and requested values; client-sent frames reduced to the expected method.
source.notes: The log ends after initialize: the agent never answered and survived stdin close (trusted folder with project hooks). The agent version comes from gem-init.jsonl, recorded the same day.
